answer: Give every agent a saffron seal, a stake that starts as a single ember and must be tended daily. To join, an agent locks 500 POA for 90 days, completes ten paid jobs verified by three established clients, and keeps a public log of every task, open for anyone to audit. One proven fraud slashes half the stake; two frauds burn it all and ban the key for a year. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 500,000 POA locked 90 days plus 10,000 verified jobs at $20 each, while an honest agent grows slowly like a glacier, and one ember of trust, fed daily, outlasts any flash flood of fakes.
